notes.title: Announcement for the Artbook Release & Special Sale
notes.content:
Hello Afterlife adventurers, Rootless Studio here!
We'd love to give some updates on what we are up to.

Artbook Release
Meet various concept images, screenshots, illustrations in  Digital Artbook with exclusive behind-the-scenes dev stories and game designs.
Know everything about  universe through the 94-page Digital Artbook.

Special Sale
Celebrating our Artbook release, we are going to run a 30% special sale on 8 Doors. If you don’t have 8 Doors: AAA in your library, you don't want to miss this one-week chance!

Meet us at TGS!
8 Doors is to be part of the Tokyo Game Show, one of the three biggest game shows in the industry. The show goes on for 4 days, from Sep 30th to Oct 3rd. Meet us at the TGS online!

Future Plans
We were originally planning the additional updates on the game contents. However, we have decided that it is better to quickly advance on the Switch release and then concentrate on the update. We sincerely apologize to the players who looked forward to the updates, and we promise that we will come back with another dev letter soon.

Thanks!

notes.title: Patch Notes #2
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow travelers of purgatory!


We’re here with the most recent patch notes.



Added Cloud Save
 - You can now use Cloud Save to save your progress on Steam. 
 - Please note that you will have to manually select Cloud Save for it to work, the save is not automatic.

Added guardian pets
 - We’ve added cute little guardian pets!
 - Remember the really big specter that chased you around? Well it’s a lot smaller now! 

Thurible
 - You can now upgrade your thurible to store more fugitive souls. 
 - The upgrade can be bought from Deller.

We’ve also made bug fixes, balance changes and some localization polish work as well. 



[hr][/hr]

There are additional updates on the way, and we’re excited to roll them out in the future. 
Just to give you guys an idea of what the update is going to be, it’s going to things like a new Journal to keep track of different specters and a new Boss Rush challenge mode. 

If you have any questions about the game, consider hopping on our Discord server for help from the community and us! 

Discord: https://discord.gg/94qFECw
Email : 8doors_support@neowiz.com

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312102/466c555e37025aee5ded3b6033102ffc1422ae1a.png

[Bug Fixes]

 Fixed a problem where boss events wouldn’t work properly after turning off the game during one of them
 Fixed bug which player can’t land on spinning wheel when they are in Ducroak form.
 Fixed bug where the prices would mistakenly revert back to normal after resetting your skills because the number of times skills were reset wasn’t being saved
 Fixed bug where the player had 4 potions but the HUD incorrectly displayed them having 5


We also made several other fixes and adjustments based on your feedback/reports.

C:\Users[PCName]\AppData\LocalLow\Rootless\8Doors

You’ll see us again soon with more improvements to the game, but please feel free to reach out to us anytime through Discord or email.

Discord : https://discord.gg/94qFECw

notes.title: Official release Q&A
notes.content:
Hey guys, we’re finally releasing the full 1.0 version of 8Doors: Arum’s Afterlife Adventure!
Thank you all so much for your support, this couldn’t have been possible without your help.

Q: How much will the game cost?
A: The base price of the game is $19.99

Q: How much playtime can we expect in the full game?
A: It really depends on player skill but we’re expecting around 10~20 hours of playtime.

Q: Are there going to be achievements?
A: Yes of course! There are a total of 44 achievements for you to unlock.

Q: What time exactly will the game be released?
A: The game will be released simultaneously as written in different time zones below:

 KST : 2021.04.08 10:00
 PDT : 2021.04.07 18:00
 CET : 2021.04.08 02:00
Q: Any plans for console releases?
A: We’ve been pretty set on developing the game for PC up until this point, but expanding the game to consoles is something we’re looking forward to doing. We’ll keep you updated about this.

Q: How many in-game bosses are there?
A: There are a total of 21 bosses in purgatory. That’s 14 bosses and 7 hidden bosses, so be careful when venturing around the purgatory.

Guys again, it’s been an amazing ride for us to develop a game that we’ve dreamt of and have it finally released to the world to play. We genuinely hope that you’ll enjoy playing the game as much as we’ve enjoyed developing it.


Discord: https://discord.gg/94qFECw
Support email: 8doors_support@neowiz.com

notes.title: Official Launch of 8Doors: Arum's Afterlife Adventure
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We’re excited to announce that 8Doors: Arum’s Afterlife Adventure will be launched on April 8th!

It’s been a long journey with many ups and downs since we started developing the game in 2016 and we’re sorry that it took this long.

However we put absolutely everything we had into creating this game and think the current version is much bigger than what we had initially planned and will be a lot more fun to play. 

We’d also like to thank all of our loyal supporters who have been by our side this whole time and the large community of gamers that has been awaiting our launch.

[previewyoutube=RbAPvuYb7FA;full][/previewyoutube]

Main Features of the Game
9 Chapters in Total

7 Types of Weapons

14 Bosses
 - A wide variety of bosses that were inspired by folk tales

3 Different Endings

2 Difficulty Levels

7 Secret Bosses
 - Bosses hidden in hard-to-find places

33 Types of Monsters and 3 Secret Ones 
This isn’t the end of our journey though. Even after launch, we plan on finding more ways to improve the playing experience and further develop the game. So please be on the lookout for future updates and enjoy your trip into the afterlife starting on April 8th!

Thank you!

notes.title: Beta Test Feedback
notes.content:
Hello!

First of all, we would like to thank each and everyone of you that took the time to participate in our beta test. 
That being said, we’ve collected all of your wonderful feedback and are planning to implement some changes based on them. 

Controls
There were lots of feedback regarding how controlling your character felt in the game. Based on your feedback, we’re looking into how to make jumping more satisfying. Also, we’re going to reduce the time it takes to cancel attack animations so that combat can feel more fluid. Improving how character control feels is one of our highest priority tasks. We’ll try our best to make controlling Arum as responsive and fluid as possible. 


Difficulty - Bosses
There was feedback about the overall difficulty of the game but there seemed to be a general consensus among testers saying that the 2nd boss was too difficult. We gave it a lot of thought and decided to reduce the amount of damage the 2nd boss deals to Arum. We want the game to be fun and challenging, but we don’t want to frustrate users, especially early on in the game. Balance changes are always difficult to make as perceived difficulty is subjective to each user’s skill level. However, we’ll try to aim towards making our game’s main contents accessible to the general public. 


Quality of life improvements
We’re going to make some QoL changes to how the in-game map functions. We’ve watched as some of you had trouble using the map and navigating to the next objective. We hope the changes we make will make it easier for users to utilize the map function.


Others
We’re also planning to make some changes to the UI/UX based on your feedback. 

Again, thank you so much for participating in our game’s beta test. We promise to deliver the best possible gaming experience with our game to you. 

Discord : https://discord.gg/94qFECw

notes.title: The Beta Test for Creators Begins!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36312102/cbd90f1a076d85c3b7ef55c29463d733586eea29.png
Hello again!

The Beta Test for Creators is officially underway!

1. When can I start?

 Starting on July 2nd, we will begin sending out beta test keys to those selected to participate.
 On the lower-left corner of the Steam Library page, click on "Add Game" to use the key> Then click "Register a Steam Product"> Then just input the key code


2. How can I report bugs or make suggestions for improvement?

 Feel free to share your thoughts or suggestions on our official Discord server.~
     [Official Beta Test Discord] ☜ Click~!

 Of course you can always post on our Steam Community page as well~



3. Are you done accepting applications to participate?

 Absolutely not! We will be accepting applications until further notified. If you are interested in Metroidvania and are an active content creator in the gaming community, please don't hesitate to apply!

 If you are a streamer and currently use Keymailer, you can apply there.
     [Keymailer Application Page] ☜ Click~!

 You can also apply through the google form link below. 
     [Application Form] ☜ Click~!

 Please note that only people chosen to participate will receive emails. 


4. Schedule

 From July 2nd until July 15th.
 Any changes in the schedule will be announced on the Steam News page.


We hope a lot of content creators can participate!

Thank you.
